mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a short-term sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and strong consumer demand (RSAFS > 450000) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment supporting robust consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with strong consumer demand
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and RSAFS > 450000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), supply chain disruptions lead to reduced corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1,100,000 units in a month, it signals strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (GDPC1) over the past 3 months indicates robust economic growth, which supports higher corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 has increased for 3 consecutive quarters, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 230.0, indicating elevated inflation, a combination of rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an impending recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, and INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) falls below 400,000 million dollars in a month, it signals weakening retail activity that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 400000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
